title: The envelope cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the envelope, unopened, actual size, on the desk. The owner holds the digest up against the light to see if there's anything inside. There isn't. It's a drawing. She says she knows that.

panels.composition: The cover: the envelope on the desk, drawn actual size, unopened, PORTLAND a block. The dog's nose at the edge.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing an unopened envelope drawn at actual size on a desk with a dog's nose at its edge, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner holding the digest up to the window. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner holding a small booklet up against a window's light while a young man and a dog watch, black and white, no words

balloons.text: I know that. I'm saying open it.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner lowering a booklet, dry, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood at the rack, not answering. The digest in. The envelope on the cover facing the room all weekend. Monday he opens it.

image.prompt: a young man placing a small booklet into a wire rack in a laundromat without replying, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox
